channels:

dependencies:

process STAR_STARSOLO {
    tag "$meta.id"
    label 'process_high'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${ workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container
?         'https://community-cr-prod.seqera.io/docker/registry/v2/blobs/sha256/5b/5b04fee93569be87eedb18990e8d297a7b75f5e6fe1cb768edbc05a1a842e160/data'
:         'community.wave.seqera.io/library/star:2.7.11b--f22f015f7eb1383f' }"

    input:
    tuple val(meta) , val(solotype), path(reads), path(manifest)
    tuple val(meta2), path(opt_whitelist)
    tuple val(meta3), path(index)
    tuple val(meta4), path(gtf)
    tuple val(meta5), path(splice_junction)

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}.Solo.out")                         , emit: counts
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}.Solo.out/Gene/raw")                , emit: raw_counts
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}.Solo.out/Gene/filtered")           , emit: filtered_counts  , optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}.Solo.out/GeneFull/raw")            , emit: raw_genefull     , optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}.Solo.out/GeneFull/filtered")       , emit: filtered_genefull, optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}.Solo.out/Velocyto/raw")            , emit: raw_velocyto     , optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}.Solo.out/Velocyto/filtered")       , emit: filtered_velocyto, optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}.Log.final.out")                    , emit: log_final
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}.Log.out")                          , emit: log_out
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}.Log.progress.out")                 , emit: log_progress
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}.Solo.out/Gene/Summary.csv")        , emit: summary          , optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}.Aligned.sortedByCoord.out.bam")    , emit: bam_sorted       , optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}.Aligned.toTranscriptome.out.bam")  , emit: bam_transcript   , optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}.Aligned.out.bam")                  , emit: bam_unsorted     , optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}*.tab")                             , emit: tab              , optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}.Aligned.out.sam")                  , emit: sam              , optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}.unmapped_{1,2}.fastq.gz")          , emit: fastq            , optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}.Chimeric.out.junction")            , emit: chimeric_junction, optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path('*.wig')                                      , emit: wig              , optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path('*.bg')                                       , emit: bedgraph         , optional: true
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('starsolo'), eval('STAR --version | sed -e "s/STAR_//g"'), topic: versions, emit: versions_starsolo

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    def gtf_arg = gtf ? "--sjdbGTFfile $gtf" : ""
    def (forward, reverse) = reads.collate(2).transpose()
    zcat = reads[0].getExtension() == "gz" ? "--readFilesCommand zcat" : ""
    def splice_junction_arg = splice_junction ? "--sjdbFileChrStartEnd $splice_junction" : ""
    def whitelist_args = opt_whitelist ? "--soloCBwhitelist ${[opt_whitelist].flatten().join(' ')}" : "--soloCBwhitelist None"
    if (solotype == "SmartSeq") {
        read_files_in = "--readFilesManifest $manifest"
    } else if (solotype in ["CB_UMI_Simple", "CB_UMI_Complex"]) {
        read_files_in = "--readFilesIn ${reverse.join( "," )} ${forward.join( "," )}"
    } else {
        error("Unknown solotype (${solotype})")
    }

    """
    STAR \\
        --genomeDir $index \\
        $read_files_in $zcat \\
        --runThreadN $task.cpus \\
        --outFileNamePrefix $prefix. \\
        --soloType $solotype \\
        $whitelist_args $gtf_arg $splice_junction_arg \\
        $args

    if [ -d ${prefix}.Solo.out ]; then
        find ${prefix}.Solo.out \\( -name "*.tsv" -o -name "*.mtx" \\) -exec gzip {} \\;
    fi
    if [ -f ${prefix}.Unmapped.out.mate1 ]; then
        mv ${prefix}.Unmapped.out.mate1 ${prefix}.unmapped_1.fastq
        gzip ${prefix}.unmapped_1.fastq
    fi
    if [ -f ${prefix}.Unmapped.out.mate2 ]; then
        mv ${prefix}.Unmapped.out.mate2 ${prefix}.unmapped_2.fastq
        gzip ${prefix}.unmapped_2.fastq
    fi
    """

    stub:
    prefix          = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    def args        = task.ext.args ?: ''
    def args_list   = (args =~ /[^\s]+/).collect()
    def feature_idx = args_list.indexOf('--soloFeatures')

    def solo_features = feature_idx >= 0
        ? args_list.subList(feature_idx + 1, args_list.findIndexOf(feature_idx + 1) { arg -> arg.startsWith('--') } < 0
            ? args_list.size()
            : args_list.findIndexOf(feature_idx + 1) { arg -> arg.startsWith('--') })
        : ['Gene']
    def solo_cell_filter = args.contains('--soloCellFilter')
        ? args.split('--soloCellFilter')[1].trim().split(/\s+/)[0]
        : 'CellRanger2.2'

    def touch_solo = solo_features.collect { feature ->
        def touch_raw = """
            mkdir -p ${prefix}.Solo.out/${feature}/raw
            echo "" | gzip > ${prefix}.Solo.out/${feature}/raw/matrix.mtx.gz
            echo "" | gzip > ${prefix}.Solo.out/${feature}/raw/barcodes.tsv.gz
            echo "" | gzip > ${prefix}.Solo.out/${feature}/raw/features.tsv.gz
        """

        def touch_filtered = solo_cell_filter != 'None' ? """
            mkdir -p ${prefix}.Solo.out/${feature}/filtered
            echo "" | gzip > ${prefix}.Solo.out/${feature}/filtered/matrix.mtx.gz
            echo "" | gzip > ${prefix}.Solo.out/${feature}/filtered/barcodes.tsv.gz
            echo "" | gzip > ${prefix}.Solo.out/${feature}/filtered/features.tsv.gz
        """ : ''

        touch_raw + touch_filtered
    }.join('\n')

    def touch_summary = solo_features.contains('Gene') ? """
        touch ${prefix}.Solo.out/Gene/Summary.csv
    """ : ''

    def touch_bam = args.contains('--outSAMtype') && args.contains('BAM') ? """
        ${args.contains('SortedByCoordinate') ? "touch ${prefix}.Aligned.sortedByCoord.out.bam" : ""}
        ${args.contains('Unsorted') ? "touch ${prefix}.Aligned.out.bam" : ""}
    """ : ""
    def touch_sam = args =~ /--outSAMtype\s+(BAM|None)/ ? "" : "touch ${prefix}.Aligned.out.sam"
    def touch_transcriptome = args.contains('--quantMode') && args.contains('TranscriptomeSAM') ? "touch ${prefix}.Aligned.toTranscriptome.out.bam" : ""

    """
    mkdir -p ${prefix}.Solo.out
    $touch_solo
    touch ${prefix}.Log.final.out
    touch ${prefix}.Log.out
    touch ${prefix}.Log.progress.out
    $touch_bam
    $touch_sam
    $touch_transcriptome
    $touch_summary
    touch ${prefix}.SJ.out.tab
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/star/starsolo"
description: "Create a counts matrix for single-cell data using STARSolo, handling\
  \ cell barcodes and UMI information."
keywords:
- "align"
- "count"
- "genome"
- "reference"
- "single-cell"
- "RNA-seq"
tools:
- starsolo:
    description: "Mapping, demultiplexing and quantification for single cell RNA-seq."
    homepage: "https://github.com/alexdobin/STAR/"
    documentation: "https://github.com/alexdobin/STAR/blob/master/docs/STARsolo.md"
    doi: "10.1101/2021.05.05.442755"
    publication:
      author: "Kaminow, B., Yunusov, D. & Dobin, A."
      year: 2021
      title: "STARsolo: accurate, fast and versatile mapping/quantification of single-cell\
        \ and single-nucleus RNA-seq data"
      source: "bioRxiv"
    licence:
    - "MIT"
    identifier: "biotools:star"
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information.\ne.g. `[ id:'test_starsolo'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - solotype:
      type: "string"
      description: "Type of single-cell library.\nIt can be CB_UMI_Simple for most\
        \ common ones such as 10xv2 and 10xv3,\nCB_UMI_Complex for method such as\
        \ inDrop and SmartSeq for SMART-Seq.\n"
  - reads:
      type: "file"
      description: "List of input FastQ files of size 1 and 2 for single-end and paired-end\
        \ data,\nrespectively.\n"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_1930"
  - manifest:
      type: "file"
      description: "Optional manifest file for Smart-Seq data.\nIt should contain\
        \ 3 tab-separated columns: read1, read2, cell_id. The cell_id column will\
        \ be added as ReadGroup tag.\n"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3475"
- - meta2:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing the barcode whitelist information."
  - opt_whitelist:
      type: "file"
      description: "Optional whitelist file"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2330"
- - meta3:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing the STAR index information."
  - index:
      type: "directory"
      description: "STAR genome index"
      pattern: "star"
- - meta4:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing the GTF information."
  - gtf:
      type: "file"
      description: "Optional GTF annotation file"
      pattern: "*.gtf"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2306"
- - meta5:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing the splice junction information."
  - splice_junction:
      type: "file"
      description: "Optional splice junction file"
      pattern: "*.tab"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3475"
output:
  counts:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information.\n"
    - ${prefix}.Solo.out:
        type: "directory"
        description: "STARSolo counts matrix"
        pattern: "*.Solo.out"
        ontologies: []
  log_final:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information.\n"
    - ${prefix}.Log.final.out:
        type: "file"
        description: "STAR final log file"
        pattern: "*Log.final.out"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2330"
  log_progress:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information.\n"
    - ${prefix}.Log.progress.out:
        type: "file"
        description: "STAR log progress file"
        pattern: "*Log.progress.out"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2330"
  summary:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information.\n"
    - ${prefix}.Solo.out/Gene/Summary.csv:
        type: "file"
        description: "STARSolo metrics summary CSV file."
        pattern: "*.Solo.out/Gene/Summary.csv"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3752"
  versions_starsolo:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - starsolo:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - STAR --version | sed -e "s/STAR_//g":
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
  raw_counts:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information.\n"
    - ${prefix}.Solo.out/Gene/raw:
        type: "directory"
        description: "STARSolo raw counts matrix"
        pattern: "*.Solo.out/Gene/raw"
        ontologies: []
  filtered_counts:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information.\n"
    - ${prefix}.Solo.out/Gene/filtered:
        type: "directory"
        description: "STARSolo filtered counts matrix (optional)"
        pattern: "*.Solo.out/Gene/filtered"
        ontologies: []
  raw_velocyto:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information.\n"
    - ${prefix}.Solo.out/Velocyto/raw:
        type: "directory"
        description: "STARSolo raw velocyto matrix (optional)"
        pattern: "*.Solo.out/Velocyto/raw"
        ontologies: []
  filtered_velocyto:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information.\n"
    - ${prefix}.Solo.out/Velocyto/filtered:
        type: "directory"
        description: "STARSolo filtered velocyto matrix (optional)"
        pattern: "*.Solo.out/Velocyto/filtered"
        ontologies: []
  bam_sorted:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information.\n"
    - ${prefix}.Aligned.sortedByCoord.out.bam:
        type: "file"
        description: "Sorted BAM file containing read alignments (optional)"
        pattern: "*.Aligned.sortedByCoord.out.bam"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2572"
  bam_transcript:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information.\n"
    - ${prefix}.Aligned.toTranscriptome.out.bam:
        type: "file"
        description: "Output BAM file of transcriptome alignment (optional)"
        pattern: "*.Aligned.toTranscriptome.out.bam"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2572"
  bam_unsorted:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information.\n"
    - ${prefix}.Aligned.out.bam:
        type: "file"
        description: "Unsorted BAM file (optional)"
        pattern: "*.Aligned.out.bam"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2572"
  fastq:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information.\n"
    - ${prefix}.unmapped_{1,2}.fastq.gz:
        type: "file"
        description: "Unmapped reads in gzipped FASTQ format (optional)"
        pattern: "*.fastq.gz"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3989"
  tab:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information.\n"
    - ${prefix}*.tab:
        type: "file"
        description: "TAB file (optional)"
        pattern: "*.tab"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3475"
  log_out:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information.\n"
    - ${prefix}.Log.out:
        type: "file"
        description: "STAR log out file"
        pattern: "*.Log.out"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2330"
  raw_genefull:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information.\n"
    - ${prefix}.Solo.out/GeneFull/raw:
        type: "directory"
        description: "STARSolo raw GeneFull matrix (optional)"
        pattern: "*.Solo.out/GeneFull/raw"
        ontologies: []
  filtered_genefull:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information.\n"
    - ${prefix}.Solo.out/GeneFull/filtered:
        type: "directory"
        description: "STARSolo filtered GeneFull matrix (optional)"
        pattern: "*.Solo.out/GeneFull/filtered"
        ontologies: []
  sam:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information.\n"
    - ${prefix}.Aligned.out.sam:
        type: "file"
        description: "SAM file (optional)"
        pattern: "*.Aligned.out.sam"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2573"
  wig:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information.\n"
    - '*.wig':
        type: "file"
        description: "STAR output wiggle format file(s) (optional)"
        pattern: "*.wig"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3005"
  bedgraph:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information.\n"
    - '*.bg':
        type: "file"
        description: "STAR output bedGraph format file(s) (optional)"
        pattern: "*.bg"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3583"
  chimeric_junction:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information.\n"
    - ${prefix}.Chimeric.out.junction:
        type: "file"
        description: "STAR chimeric junction output file (optional)"
        pattern: "*Chimeric.out.junction"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3475"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - starsolo:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"

        type: "eval"
